info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be powerful, to be capable, to be competent

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: SaktimAna honA, yogya honA, pUrRa honA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: proTati = sUdati ' iti mantravyAKyAyAM vyAKyAnAt, ' apaproTa = mAraya ' iti vyAKyAnAcca BawwaBAskaramate hiMsArTakoyaM DAtuH iti mA.DA.vfttidarSanAt jYAyate . ' paryAptigatO ' ityapi kvacidarTanirdeSaH kftaH . ' apaproTanam = huNkaraRam ' iti kzure ' mA.DA.vfttiH . ' SabdArTopi . apapUrvastu mAraRe huNkaraRe vA ' iti DA.kA. vyAKyAne (2 - 25) .

examples: 'apa proTa dunduBe ducCunA itaH' (vA॰saM॰29.56). apakftyApakftya nASayetyuvawaH.
